messages:
sam_support: FYI flagging an urgent handoff — Veridian Health trial just hit a blocker: tokenization errors causing embed ingestion to fail and trial customer is stalled. Raising support->CS escalation.

maya_cs: thanks for the heads up. can you paste the recent error log and estimate how long this will block activation? we need to warn the customer and align next steps. @jordan_pm FYI on possible demo fallout.

sam_support: copying logs — short excerpt below, full ticket linked: https://support.redwood/INC-8192
```
2026-02-17T14:12:03Z ERROR ingest: tokenizer failed: invalid byte sequence at position 1024
...
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "ingest_worker.py", line 212, in process_batch
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)
  File "tokenizers/core.py", line 89, in encode
    raise TokenizationError("invalid byte")
TokenizationError: invalid byte sequence
```
Estimate: engineers say likely a data-cleaning issue on customer side but we need 2-3 hours to confirm.

maya_cs: ok. comms plan proposal: 1) immediate message to Veridian PM acknowledging issue + ETA for investigation (by EOD). 2) offer guided session to reformat ingest pipeline (30-60 min). 3) provide fallback: manual CSV ingest we can process on CS side to keep trial progressing. Thoughts?

jordan_pm: agree with plan. add: include a short checklist customers can run to pre-validate payloads (we have a quick script) and offer a one-time data-cleaning assist. I'll draft the checklist.

liam_se: quick technical note — the TokenizationError often comes from unnormalized unicode (e.g., stray 0xFF bytes) or null bytes in the payload. If customer uses Java-based client, they sometimes double-encode. I can attach a mini repro and a sanitize script that removes problematic bytes.

maya_cs: perfect. owners: sam_support (incident ticket) for triage comms, liam_se for remediation script, jordan_pm for checklist + enablement doc, maya_cs will own customer comms and the fallback CSV offer. Timeline: initial customer ack within 30m, investigation update in 2 hours, remediation options within 6 hours.

sam_support: ack — sending initial note now: "Thanks — seeing ingestion error, investigating, ETA 2 hours. We'll follow up with remediation options and a temporary workaround."

cs_bot: Reminder: create an escalation runbook entry and tag as high-priority trial-impact (auto). Link created: https://console.redwood/escalations/1765432100

jordan_pm: Draft checklist snippet (will prod into GH later):
```
# pre-ingest-check.sh
python - <<'PY'
import sys,unicodedata
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
  s=open(f,'rb').read()
  s=s.replace(b'\x00',b'')
  try:
    s.decode('utf-8')
  except UnicodeDecodeError:
    print('BAD:',f)
    sys.exit(1)
print('OK')
PY
```

liam_se: I'll drop a sanitize script into the support ticket and attach a short repro so they can run locally. If they can't, we can run the CSV fallback.

maya_cs: customer comms sent (copy below):
"Hi Veridian team — thanks for your patience. We’re seeing an ingestion tokenizer error and are investigating now. ETA for next update: 2 hours. Options we’re preparing: a quick sanitize script you can run, or we can accept a CSV export and process ingestion on our side to keep your trial active. Would you prefer a call now or the CSV fallback? — Maya, CS"

sam_support: Veridian replied: "Call now pls, we can jump in 15m"

maya_cs: scheduling 15m enablement call and adding liam_se + sam_support. After call we’ll either: 1) validate and unblock, or 2) accept CSV fallback and log manual ingest steps. I'll update the escalation runbook with outcome.

liam_se: on the call — found a null byte in one example file. Ran sanitize script, ingestion succeeded for the sample. pushing sanitize script to ticket and to shared enablement repo.

jordan_pm: I'll finalize the one-pager for onboarding teams to include the new pre-ingest checklist and sample script. Recommend we bake this into trial onboarding emails to reduce recurrence.

maya_cs: closing loop: trial unblocked, customer accepted a post-trial enablement session to harden pipeline. follow-ups: - jordan_pm to add checklist to enablement docs (owner) - liam_se to PR sanitize script into repo (owner) - sam_support to mark support ticket resolved with notes and notify billing we can resume trial meter. thanks team :thumbsup:
